missing_diagram_candidates.classification: editorial candidate; not a confirmed defect
missing_diagram_candidates.rationale: The definition gives two opposite factorization equations around a fixed complementary channel; a small map could distinguish the degrading and antidegrading directions.
missing_diagram_candidates.draw_or_check: Draw input A feeding N to B and N^c to E; for degradable, draw B --D--> E and check N^c=D∘N; for antidegradable, draw E --A--> B and check N=A∘N^c. Label that the dilation is fixed.

missing_diagram_candidates.classification: editorial candidate; not a confirmed defect
missing_diagram_candidates.rationale: The statement defines a two-rate region by two individual bounds and a sum-rate bound; a generic first-quadrant polygon could make the intersection structure easier to see.
missing_diagram_candidates.draw_or_check: Use R1 and R2 axes; mark R1≤κlog2(1+SNR1), R2≤κlog2(1+SNR2), and the active sum-rate line R1+R2≤κ min{log2(1+SNR1+INR1), log2(1+SNR2+INR2)}. Preserve that the intercept and slope depend on channel parameters; do not add numeric coordinates.
